svg.text: Batch with the input never ending. Events are processed
"Image resize jobs go on SQS, since they are independent with per-message
Another group reads the same data independently with its own
offsets. Adding consumers doesn't cost the producer anything.
DB says 120, search says 100: permanently inconsistent
+ if the 2nd write fails, the two systems also disagree
And if the app crashes between the two writes, one system
has the change and the other doesn't. Writing to two systems
Every derived system (search, cache, warehouse) consumes the
log and updates itself. Each can be rebuilt by replaying from
offset 0, or from a snapshot plus the log.
State is a derived view, a fold over the events. You can build
new views later by replaying, and debug by replaying to any
Sliding: all events within 5 min of each other
Session: closes after N min of inactivity
Session: group a user's activity until a gap, as in web analytics
Keep a local copy of the
Replay means some outputs are sent twice.
Kafka partitioned by ad_id → Flink 1-min tumbling windows on event
time → OLAP store. Raw clicks to S3 for batch reconciliation.
"Keep search, cache, and DB in sync?"
CDC (Debezium) or outbox → Kafka → idempotent consumers. Never
Ordering, replay, or many consumers → Kafka. Independent tasks with
effectively-once. I make the consumer idempotent with an event ID."
Study notes on Designing Data-Intensive Applications (Kleppmann). Read the book.
